public_mechanism.official_source: Bazel Remote Caching and Glossary documentation
source_supported_core: build actions have explicitly declared inputs and outputs
the action cache maps deterministic action keys to prior results
action keys incorporate action metadata while input checksums represent declared input state
unchanged action identity can reuse cached outputs whereas changed relevant inputs/action metadata invalidate that reuse
public_mechanism.adaptation: Represent only a bounded dependency set and changed-dimension set in role-local durable state. Disjoint declared dependencies permit evidence identity reuse without new credit; overlap or undeclared dependencies require current-scope re-evaluation. No Bazel process, remote cache, hosted runner, or external build service is on the accepted route.

scope_limit: Constructed three-record/three-dimension role-local revalidation trace only. Bazel sources support declared-input/action-key reuse semantics; the scope-dimension mapping and fail-closed undeclared-dependency rule are the Chat adaptation, not a claim of Bazel equivalence.
exact_next_action: After independent readback, advance once with credit_delta=1. Next leaf should test dependency-underdeclaration: if later evidence shows a supposedly unaffected record actually depended on a changed dimension, quarantine the reused record and every credit transition derived solely from it without rewriting immutable history. Precommit provenance-taint propagation before any new public semantic read.
